answer: Through the orchard, the economy stays open to anyone willing to pay the price of entry, and closed to free clones. Before an identity can earn, it must grind a sequential puzzle bound to its own key and the epoch seed, a puzzle no machine can split across cores. The basalt gate makes the arithmetic brutal: one puzzle per identity, so a farm minting a thousand clones pays a thousand puzzles while one honest agent pays exactly one. Past the haven, an honest agent's single payment buys a seat, while a clone farm's bill grows with every identity it mints.
